title: ADÉLA to Make Late Night Debut With ‘Tonight Show’ Interview & Performance
contentText:
It’s official: the baddest late night programs ain’t in L.A. ADÉLA has chosen The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon in New York City for her nighttime talk show debut.

Related

The Slovak pop star will appear on the Thursday (Oct. 22) episode of the Jimmy Fallon-hosted show, as revealed Monday (Oct. 19). In addition to performing as she hangs out at 30 Rock for the night, ADÉLA will also spend some time on the couch for an interview with the SNL alum.

That night, Kristen Bell and Joe Manganiello will make appearances as well.

ADÉLA is one of music’s most in-demand stars right now, so it makes sense Tonight is eager to talk to her. Billboard recently found a moment in her hectic schedule to chat about “Ain’t in LA,” her first-ever Billboard Hot 100 hit that reached No. 27 in October, as well as “Nicole Kidman,” which just hit the top 10 on the chart.

“I never in my mind doubted that it would happen,” she told Billboard of her whirlwind success at the time. “I don’t know if that’s conceited to say, but … I feel like I have heart, and I have something to say.”

As it happens, the namesake of ADÉLA’s biggest hit to date also recently swung by Fallon and chatted about the Dream Academy alum.

“I can’t believe it,” Nicole Kidman told Fallon in September . “She wrote a song called ‘Nicole Kidman,’ [and] I’m like, ‘Who is that person?’ She’s so talented.”

The Tonight Show episode featuring ADÉLA is set to air from 11:35 p.m. to 12:35 a.m. ET/PT on NBC on Thursday and will be available to stream on Peacock.
